thread:
carmen: Quick heads-up — planning to cut release/1.14 tomorrow 17:00 UTC. Need 1-2 owners for backports, changelog/version bump, and someone to watch CI during the cut.
ryan: Do we want to use branch-bot to create the branch or should I do it manually? I don't want to step on anyone.
carmen: branch-bot will create it if we trigger the job, but if someone wants to create it manually that's fine. Manual commands:```
git checkout -b release/1.14
git push origin release/1.14
```
anya: Quick policy reminder: only bugfixes, critical fixes, and CI/backport-only PRs are allowed after cutoff. No feature backports unless PM + eng lead signoff.
josh: I'll take changelog + version bump (I'll open PR against release/1.14 once branch exists).
lisa: I'll own cherry-pick triage — please label PRs with `backport/v1.14` and add `backport-needed` if it's waiting on review.
ryan: For reviewers on cherry-picks, can we standardize on @josh and @lisa as first pass? Saves cycling.
carmen: yes — add them as default reviewers. Also please include the original PR link in the description and the commit SHA.
branch-bot: Created branch release/1.14 at commit abc1234 — https://git.example.com/redwood/repo/branches/release/1.14 :branch:
anya: Callout — cutoff is 2026-04-01 17:00 UTC. After that, emergency-only with PM signoff + release-manager approval.
ryan: Ack. I'll queue my cherry-pick PRs today. Any preference on PR title format?
josh: Format we used previously worked well: `cherry-pick: <original-pr-number> - <short-desc>` and include `[backport v1.14]` in body.
lisa: Also add the `release-note: none` or short note in the changelog entry if it's user-visible.
carmen: CI expectation: run full suite on release branch for any backport that touches runtime or infra. Lighter smoke OK for docs/README tweaks.
ryan: Understood. I'll avoid touching infra tests unless necessary.
branch-bot: Smoke job queued for release/1.14 — https://ci.example.com/builds/555 (status: queued)
josh: I'll open the changelog PR after branch creation and ping the docs folks.
anya: One more: please don't request backports for WIP or draft PRs. We keep a short queue.
carmen: tagging @release-managers for final signoff at T-1h. If anyone needs elevated perms to push, ping me. Thanks all. :tada:
ryan: Thanks — I'll post a short checklist in the release-docs channel once I start.
lisa: prepping a spreadsheet to track cherry-picks, will share link here when ready.
branch-bot: Smoke job started (build 555) — status: running
carmen: Good. If smoke passes and no major blockers, we'll proceed with cut at 17:00 UTC. Otherwise we'll delay by up to 2 hours and re-evaluate.
ryan: :thumbsup:
josh: thanks everyone.
branch-bot: Smoke job completed — success. Artifacts: https://ci.example.com/builds/555/artifacts
carmen: Excellent — proceeding unless anyone objects. Final reminder: add `backport/v1.14` label and set base to `release/1.14` for PRs.
anya: No objections from me.
lisa: shared spreadsheet: https://docs.example.com/spreadsheets/d/1A2B3C (I'll add PR rows now)
ryan: posted checklist in release-docs. Good luck cutting.
carmen: Cut started. I will ping when branch is protected and release branch rules are applied.
branch-bot: Branch release/1.14 protected, required checks: ci/unit, ci/integration, codecov.
carmen: Branch cut complete, changelog PR created by @josh, and I'll kick off the rollback playbook smoke in case we need it.
josh: PR link: https://git.example.com/redwood/repo/pulls/789 — added version bump, changelog notes.
ryan: Reviewing now.
lisa: Triage done for queued cherry-picks. I'll assign reviews.
carmen: Thanks everyone — we can monitor for a day and merge backports as they pass. :party_popper:
